data.one_liner: Simple and declarative access to the Google Static Maps service.
data.what_it_does: Provides a StaticMap widget and StaticMapController to fetch and render Google Static Maps images in Flutter. Supports markers, paths, custom styles, and encoded polylines out of the box.
use_when: You want to display a non-interactive static map image using the Google Static Maps API.
You need to render markers, paths, and custom styles onto a map image without the overhead of an interactive map widget.
avoid_when: You need a fully interactive, scrollable, and zoomable map widget.
You want to use a free or open-source alternative to Google Maps.
strengths: Declarative API for building static map URLs and widgets
Supports markers, paths, circles, and styling features
Provides both a widget and a controller for image providers
weaknesses: Limited to static map images rather than interactive maps
Requires a valid Google Maps API key
data.setup_notes: Requires a Google Maps API key to query the Google Static Maps service.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick google_maps_flutter if you need a fully interactive, native map instead of a static map image.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick flutter_map if you prefer open-source map tiles instead of Google Maps.

data.minimal_example:
StaticMap(
  googleApiKey: "<REPLACE-WITH-GOOGLE-API-KEY>",
  width: 400,
  height: 400,
  zoom: 14,
  visible: const [
    GeocodedLocation.address('Santa Monica Pier'),
  ],
)
